title: Coal Racket - Giving Rise To Political Suspects

page_data.en:
SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SP. BR. REGISTRY.
N. 1528 (c)
April 25, 1942.
Date 24 / 4 / 42

COAL RACKET: GIVING RISE TO POLITICAL SUSPECTS

According to information obtained by members of the
Special Branch Headquarters, the practice of a wholesale pillage
of large quantities of coal is being carried on during nightfalls
from (1) the M.B.K. Coal Yard and other places in Pootung, (2)
vessels calling at the port from Japan as well as (3) inland
steamers plying between local ports, through the conspiracy of
a well-known stevedore named Lee ( 李 ) who in turn disposes of
his stolen property to the following receivers:-

1) Wong Pah-sung ( 王柏生 )
2) Auh Teh-piao ( 瞿德標 )
3) Auh Teh-ngao ( 瞿德敖 )
4) Bao Kwang-yuen ( 光遠 )
5) Tsih Siao-fu ( 戚小甫 )

A few of the foregoing receivers are reported to be
under the suspicion of supplying the commodity to the guerilla
forces operating in Pootung and Eastern Chekiang Province and
one of them named Bao Kwang-yuen has recently left Shanghai for
Ningpo.

The above receivers are known to visit the Coal Merchants
Guild, Tientsin Road, between 1 and 3 p.m. on week-days and are
also known to be the followers of a Japanese subject named
NOBUO SATO who is reported to be a secret service agent in the
employ of the local Japanese Gendarmerie but who, however, has no
connection with the affair whatsoever.

The deposit places of the stolen commodity are located
at Tangkew in Pootung and in Nantao, and the transportation is
generally effected through the assistance of two Japanese named
TAKEO ONO and FUJIWARA in the Pootung area, while TAIICHI MATSUMOTO
is assisting transportation in the Nantao area. The trio are
believed to be of the ronin class.

（批：The case is handled by C / in conjunction with S B）
（印：柳 本 17 5 2）
page_data.zh:
秘密
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别科档案室
编号 1528 (c)
1942年4月25日
日期 1942年4月24日

煤炭勒索案：引发政治嫌疑

据特别科总部人员获得的情报，在一名名叫李（Lee）的知名码头工人的阴谋策划下，夜间正大规模发生公然掠夺大量煤炭的行为。被盗煤炭来源包括：(1) 浦东的 M.B.K. 煤栈及其他地点，(2) 从日本抵达本港的船只，以及 (3) 在各本地港口之间往来的内河轮船。李随即将其赃物出售给下列收赃者：

1) 王柏生 (Wong Pah-sung)
2) 瞿德標 (Auh Teh-piao)
3) 瞿德敖 (Auh Teh-ngao)
4) 光遠 (Bao Kwang-yuen)
5) 戚小甫 (Tsih Siao-fu)

据报道，上述部分收赃者涉嫌向在浦东及浙江省东部活动的游击队供应物资，其中一名名叫光遠 (Bao Kwang-yuen) 的人最近已离开上海前往宁波。

已知上述收赃者于工作日午后1时至3时期间前往天津路的煤炭同业公会。另悉，他们是一名名为 NOBUO SATO 的日本人的追随者。据报道，NOBUO SATO 是受雇于当地日本宪兵队的特务机关特工，但他与此事毫无关联。

赃物的存放地点位于浦东的唐家渡（Tangkew）和南市，运输工作通常在两名日本人 TAKEO ONO 和 FUJIWARA 的协助下于浦东地区进行，而 TAIICHI MATSUMOTO 则协助在南市地区进行运输。据信，此三人属于浪人阶层。

（批注：本案由刑事科会同特别科处理）
（印章：柳 本 17 5 2）

The stolen coal is later transferred to the ownership
of the following dealers who manage to have their stock
stored at the following addresses in the International
Settlement:-

Dealers:
1) Zung Kyung-pao (陈金宝)
2) Zung Ping-keng (陈炳根)
3) Wong Zeu-foh (王传福)
4) Auh Ngoh-dien (夏玉田)
5) Siao Ming Po (小毛波)

Storage bases
1) Kwang Mau-chong (广茂昌) inside Lane 140 Sinza Road.
2) Ming Foh Loong (民福隆) and Yoong Chong (雍昌),
West of Wing On Godown (永安栈), along the river
(North bank) of Soochow Creek near Chekiang Road
Bridge.

被盗煤炭随后被转至下列经销商名下，这些经销商设法将其库存存放在国际租界内的以下地址：

经销商：
1) 陈金宝 (Zung Kyung-pao)
2) 陈炳根 (Zung Ping-keng)
3) 王传福 (Wong Zeu-foh)
4) 夏玉田 (Auh Ngoh-dien)
5) 小毛波 (Siao Ming Po)

仓储基地
1) 新闸路140弄内的广茂昌 (Kwang Mau-chong)。
2) 民福隆 (Ming Foh Loong) 和雍昌 (Yoong Chong)，位于浙江路桥附近苏州河（北岸）永安栈西侧沿河地带。
